text: BAM share fell 0.11 percentage points over 23 hours, while the 7-day change is a 0.02 percentage-point rise, leaving BAM at 32.7% of all Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee leads with 23.4% of BAM stake and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 58 stake-leadership changes this window are best read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover.
